currency.basis: Mark observed in live use 2026-10-02 on the bank's main site header and online-banking login; registry shows the bank operating with a charter amended 14.05.2026; Kommersant dates the design to the current brand period (from Nov 2024).

identity.basis: CB Russia registry binds uralfd.ru/bankdom.ru to АО КБ «Урал ФД» (ОГРН 1025900000048, license 249, Perm); Kommersant confirms the bank's membership in the Дом.ру/ЭР-Телеком group and the Nov-2024 rebrand. Distinct from Банк ДОМ.РФ (domrfbank.ru) — verified separate entity.

assessment.independenceRationale: State registry (Bank of Russia), two bank-owned web properties, and independent press (Kommersant) agree on entity, group membership, rebrand timing and the mark.
uncertainties: No mark-only SVG is published; the candidate isolates paths 1–3 of the official lockup (lossless subset) because carving from the official vector is the only route to a standalone mark and the raster favicon is research-only.

Record title «Дом.ру Банк» reflects the previous retail brand; current naming varies («Банк Урал ФД» site title, «урал фд банк» in online banking, press «Дом.ру»). The mark itself is identical across surfaces; metadata wording may deserve a separate correction.

variant.basis: Positive red #FF312C lockup (site header) and white-on-dark variant (online-banking login) of the same three-glyph mark; the standalone mark is officially used in the app-style favicon. No mark-only SVG is published; the candidate is the lossless subset of the official lockup's first three paths.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All three glyphs complete with their interior cutouts preserved (circle notch, square notch); no detail loss, no clipping at any size tested; gradients none, flat #FF312C only.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Original wide 72.95×26 proportions preserved without distortion; the mark fits the square cell using the catalog's standard centered icon area at useful size and remains recognizable on both themes.
candidate.rationale: Standalone three-glyph mark of the bank's current brand period (from the Nov-2024 Дом.ру ecosystem rebrand), isolated losslessly from the official header lockup vector; the bank uses the same mark standalone in its official favicon and identically in the online-banking white variant, so the mark-only form is the officially supported icon form. The separate «урал фд» wordmark is excluded per the catalog standalone-mark rule.
candidate.role: Standalone bank mark (three glyphs: triangle, circle with notch, notched square) in the bank's brand red.
transforms: Isolated the first three paths of the official 13-path lockup SVG byte-for-byte (no path data, fill or geometry edits); the mark is a lossless subset of the original vector.
Narrowed the canvas to the mark bounds with viewBox="0 0 72.95 26"; no scaling or translation of the emblem, no rotation, no color changes, no background added.
Removed the full-canvas clip rect (clip0_8157_146) that existed only as the lockup's canvas clip; it clipped no mark pixels.

SVGO 4.1.0 with repository svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e) on a copy: 1003 -> 781 bytes (-22.1%), selected. rsvg-convert renders of working vs optimized at 480 px differ only in 15 edge-antialiasing pixels (max alpha delta 11), no geometry change.
candidate.variant: Positive red #FF312C mark on transparency, matching the official site-header positive variant; white-on-dark login variant confirms the same geometry.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this record, so the candidate replaces an absent icon with the bank's current standalone mark; there is no prior icon to compare against.

proposals.reason: Operating bank АО КБ «Урал ФД» (license 249, active per CB Russia) rebranded in Nov 2024 into the Дом.ру ecosystem (Kommersant 2024-11-28); its current official identity is a three-glyph mark (triangle, circle with notch, notched square) in #FF312C, published as original vector on uralfd.ru and dbo.bankdom.ru and observed live 2026-10-02. The standalone mark occupies the first three paths of the official header lockup; the wordmark «урал фд» is separate lettering excluded from catalog suitability. Not Банк ДОМ.РФ (distinct entity, verified).

sourceCandidate.rationale: Genuine original vector from the bank's official site (template asset, not traced): 13 clean paths, brand color #FF312C. The first three paths are the standalone three-glyph bank mark, officially used standalone in the favicon and identically in the login variant; the remaining paths are the separate «урал фд» wordmark excluded by the catalog suitability rule. White variant of the same mark confirmed at https://dbo.bankdom.ru/ru/img/ib/logo_login.svg. Represents the record's current brand period.

sources.observation: Downloaded header lockup SVG from the current site titled «Банк Урал ФД» (255×26, 13 paths, #FF312C): three-glyph mark (paths 1–3) + «урал фд» wordmark. Rendered inspection confirms the mark design.
Current site titled «Банк Урал ФД»; header lockup SVG 255×26, 13 paths, #FF312C: three-glyph mark (paths 1–3) + «урал фд» wordmark. Rendered inspection confirms the mark design.
Online-banking login shows the same three-glyph mark + «урал фд банк» wordmark as a white variant (328×33 SVG), confirming the mark across official surfaces.
Kommersant Perm, 2024-11-28: «Банк «Урал ФД» становится банком «Дом.ру»» — rebrand effective from end of November 2024 within the Дом.ру/ЭР-Телеком ecosystem; dates the current brand period.

CB Russia registry: АО КБ «Урал ФД» (АКБ «Уральский финансовый дом»), Perm, license 249, ОГРН 1025900000048, status «Действует», charter amended 14.05.2026; official sites include uralfd.ru and bankdom.ru.
App-style favicon: standalone three-glyph mark over «банк» on a red-to-orange gradient squircle. Research-only raster; confirms the mark is used standalone in icon contexts.
